program:
(rule!
  (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([obj (in-list (objects g 0))])
    (let* ((h (obj-h obj))
           (w (obj-w obj))
           (color (cond [(> h w) 2] [(> w h) 3] [else 4])))
      (paint-cells out (obj-cells obj) color))))
rival_program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
      (let* ([objs (objects g 0)]
             [anchor (if (empty? objs) #f (argmax (lambda (o) (* (obj-h o) (obj-w o))) objs))]
             [rh (if anchor (obj-h anchor) 1)]
             [rw (if anchor (obj-w anchor) 1)])
        (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([obj (in-list objs)])
          (let* ([left (* (obj-h obj) rw)] [right (* (obj-w obj) rh)] [color (cond [(> left right) 2] [(< left right) 3] [else 4])])
            (paint-cells out (obj-cells obj) color))))))
